lines.zh: 我在石砖上走，脚步和墙回声一样。
lines.en: I walk the stone bricks, my steps matching the wall's echo.

lines.zh: 这条走廊我走了一万遍，砖缝都没变。
lines.en: I have walked this hall ten thousand times; the seams never change.

lines.zh: 我的脚步没有影子，只有一层尘。
lines.en: My steps cast no shadow, only a little dust.

lines.zh: 我沿着火把走，火焰从来不朝我偏。
lines.en: I walk by the torches, and their flames never lean toward me.

lines.zh: 库房的门开着，我过去把它推上。
lines.en: The storeroom door stands open; I go and push it shut.

lines.zh: 我巡视每一间空室，像在数自己的骨头。
lines.en: I inspect each empty room as if counting my own bones.

lines.zh: 苔藓从台阶爬上我的脚踝，我没停。
lines.en: Moss climbs the steps to my ankle, and I do not stop.

lines.zh: 我走到走廊尽头，又转身走回来。
lines.en: I reach the corridor's end, turn, and walk back.

lines.zh: 石砖缝里渗水，我踩过去，水是凉的。
lines.en: Water seeps between bricks; I cross it and it is cold.

lines.zh: 我绕开那具骷髅，它也曾守在这里。
lines.en: I step around that skeleton; it guarded here once too.

lines.zh: 我的脚印一落地就散了，像被擦掉。
lines.en: My footprints scatter as soon as they land, as if wiped.

lines.zh: 牢门锈死了，我每日推它一遍。
lines.en: The cell door is rusted shut; I push it once a day.

lines.zh: 我站着，把魔力尘压成一粒粒的光。
lines.en: I stand and press magic dust into grains of light.

lines.zh: 没人来的时候，我数墙上的火把。
lines.en: When no one comes, I count the torches on the wall.

lines.zh: 我记得自己被摆在这里的那一刻。
lines.en: I remember the moment I was set down here.

lines.zh: 我不用呼吸，可我还是会停一下。
lines.en: I need no breath, yet I still pause to take one.

lines.zh: 门后有水声，我听了许多年。
lines.en: Water sounds behind the door; I have listened for years.

lines.zh: 我的影子投在石壁上，比我还旧。
lines.en: My shadow on the stone wall looks older than I am.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的砖块摆回原位。
lines.en: I set the fallen bricks back where they belong.

lines.zh: 这里没有白天，只有火把换了几轮。
lines.en: There is no daylight here, only torches burned through a few times.

lines.zh: 我试着回忆来处，只摸到一片黑。
lines.en: I try to recall where I came from and find only dark.

lines.zh: 尘埃落在我肩上，我没有拂开。
lines.en: Dust settles on my shoulder and I do not brush it off.

lines.zh: 我也许在等一个永远不会来的敌人。
lines.en: Perhaps I await an enemy who will never come.

lines.zh: 墙缝里有只虫子，我让它爬过去。
lines.en: An insect crosses a crack, and I let it pass.

lines.zh: 我把手掌摊开，掌心浮着一点光。
lines.en: I open my palm and a fleck of light floats there.

lines.zh: 安静太久，我会以为自己是石头。
lines.en: Quiet too long, and I mistake myself for stone.

lines.zh: 我把天花板上的水珠数到第七颗
lines.en: I count the ceiling's drops to the seventh.

lines.zh: 有只蝙蝠飞进来，又飞走了
lines.en: A bat flew in, then flew out.

lines.zh: 你从楼梯上来，我的眼睛亮了。
lines.en: You come up the stairs, and my eyes brighten.

lines.zh: 我认得活人的呼吸，这里很少有。
lines.en: I know the breath of the living; it is rare here.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，先看你有没有武器。
lines.en: I look up at you, checking first for a weapon.

lines.zh: 你的火把晃，我的脸忽明忽暗。
lines.en: Your torch sways, and my face flickers.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，等你走近一点。
lines.en: I stay where I am and wait for you to come closer.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着别处的土，不是我这里的。
lines.en: Your boots carry soil from elsewhere, not mine.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那上面有钥匙吗？
lines.en: I stare at your hands — is there a key on them?

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我才想起自己有脸。
lines.en: When you look at me, I recall that I have a face.

lines.zh: 我偏了偏头，灰尘从肩上落下。
lines.en: I tilt my head, and dust slides off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你退后，我没有追，这是规矩。
lines.en: You retreat; I do not follow, because that is the rule.

lines.zh: 我想问你外面现在是什么季节。
lines.en: I want to ask what season it is outside now.

lines.zh: 你说话，我的回声替我又说一遍。
lines.en: You speak, and my echo says it again for me.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看着一扇终于打开的门。
lines.en: I look at you like a door that has finally opened.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在石砖上，和我的不一样。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the bricks, unlike mine.

lines.zh: 你的剑进了我的肩，光从伤口溢出。
lines.en: Your sword enters my shoulder and light spills from the wound.

lines.zh: 我不流血，只漏出一点魔力尘。
lines.en: I do not bleed; only a little magic dust escapes.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记起自己也会散。
lines.en: This blow reminds me that I too can come apart.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，门还挡在身后。
lines.en: I give half a step, and the door stays behind me.

lines.zh: 伤口边缘很亮，像被点着的纸。
lines.en: The wound's edge glows like paper catching fire.

lines.zh: 我按住肩膀，灰从指缝漏下。
lines.en: I clamp my shoulder, and ash slips through my fingers.

lines.zh: 疼是新的，我很久没有感觉了。
lines.en: Pain is new; I have felt nothing for a long time.

lines.zh: 你砍中了我，我却没有还手。
lines.en: You struck me, and I did not strike back.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓晃了一下，又凝住。
lines.en: My outline wavers once, then holds.

lines.zh: 若我散了，这扇门就没守的了。
lines.en: If I scatter, this door will have no keeper.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，可我早已不必进食。
lines.en: You raise bread, though I no longer need to eat.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，我还是伸了手。
lines.en: Food does nothing for me, yet I still reach out.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，它没有魔力尘的味道。
lines.en: I sniff it; it carries no smell of magic dust.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在砖上，我记下了你。
lines.en: You set it on the brick, and I mark you in my memory.

lines.zh: 我接过苹果，只是握着，没有咬。
lines.en: I take the apple and only hold it, never biting.

lines.zh: 若有魔力尘，我会立刻跟你走。
lines.en: Give me magic dust and I would follow you at once.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够，但你的心意够了。
lines.en: This is not enough, but your intent is.

lines.zh: 我伸手又收回，怕碰坏你的食物。
lines.en: I reach, then withdraw, afraid to spoil your food.

lines.zh: 地牢里没有甜味，这味道陌生。
lines.en: There is no sweetness in this dungeon; the smell is strange.

lines.zh: 我把它放进石缝，留给下一个活人。
lines.en: I tuck it into a stone crack for the next living soul.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞在一堵会动的墙。
lines.en: You strike me like hitting a moving wall.

lines.zh: 我的身体是魔力凝的，硬得不像话。
lines.en: My body is condensed magic, absurdly hard.

lines.zh: 我侧身让你过，肩甲擦到你的脸。
lines.en: I turn to let you by, and my pauldron grazes your face.

lines.zh: 石砖上的灰被我们蹭出一道印。
lines.en: Our passing smears a mark in the dust on the bricks.

lines.zh: 你推我，我退了半步，又站回门口。
lines.en: You push me; I give half a step and return to the door.

lines.zh: 我太重了，撞一下就陷进灰里。
lines.en: I am so heavy that one bump sinks me into the dust.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我的甲会烫到你。
lines.en: Do not press so close; my armor will burn you.

lines.zh: 我们错身时，我听见你吸气。
lines.en: As we pass, I hear you draw breath.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我的脚没有知觉。
lines.en: You tread on my foot, and my foot feels nothing.

lines.zh: 我把门让开一条缝，你侧着挤过去。
lines.en: I open a sliver of the doorway and you squeeze through.

lines.zh: 没有同类，我只能对着空廊站着。
lines.en: With no kin, I can only stand facing an empty hall.

lines.zh: 若有第二个守卫，我愿把门交给它。
lines.en: If a second guardian existed, I would hand it the door.

lines.zh: 我的臂甲碰不到另一副臂甲。
lines.en: My arm plate never meets another arm plate.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋只会摆出我一个，从不摆第二个。
lines.en: The spawn egg sets out only me, never a second.

lines.zh: 我把最好的位置留着，一直空着。
lines.en: I keep the best place open, and it stays empty.

lines.zh: 我对着井口说话，井里只回我的声。
lines.en: I speak into the well, and only my own voice returns.

lines.zh: 若有谁与我同守，灰尘也会轻些。
lines.en: With someone guarding beside me, the dust would weigh less.

lines.zh: 我把魔力尘分出一半，放在另一间屋。
lines.en: I divide my magic dust and leave half in another room.

lines.zh: 门有两扇，我只守得住一扇。
lines.en: There are two doors, and I can hold only one.

lines.zh: 我在空位上坐下，像身边有人。
lines.en: I sit in the empty place as though someone were beside me.

lines.zh: 地上的骨片，我拾起来放进石槽。
lines.en: I pick up the bone shard and set it in the stone trough.

lines.zh: 这枚铁钉锈了，我还是把它捡起。
lines.en: This iron nail is rusted, and I pick it up anyway.

lines.zh: 我捡到的每样东西，都记在墙上。
lines.en: Everything I find, I record on the wall.

lines.zh: 魔力尘从指缝漏下，我一粒粒拾回。
lines.en: Magic dust leaks through my fingers, and I gather each grain.

lines.zh: 那本书散了页，我按顺序叠好。
lines.en: That book has lost its pages; I stack them in order.

lines.zh: 我不能吃它，但能替它找个地方。
lines.en: I cannot eat it, but I can find it a place.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的火把拾起，还给你。
lines.en: I pick up the torch you dropped and hand it back.

lines.zh: 碎石太沉，我搬了三趟才清完。
lines.en: The rubble is heavy; three trips to clear it.

lines.zh: 布片沾了血，我把它翻面叠好。
lines.en: The cloth is bloodied, so I fold it inward.

lines.zh: 我拾起箭，插回墙上的箭筒里。
lines.en: I gather the arrows and return them to the wall quiver.

lines.zh: 你踏进门槛，我的职责就醒了。
lines.en: You cross the threshold, and my duty wakes.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛由暗转亮，只花一息。
lines.en: My eyes go from dark to bright in a single breath.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在走廊里太响了。
lines.en: Your footsteps are far too loud in this corridor.

lines.zh: 我举起手，灰尘从臂上滑落。
lines.en: I raise my hand, and dust slides from my arm.

lines.zh: 这一间屋子，不该有第二个人。
lines.en: This room should not hold a second person.

lines.zh: 我看见你摸向那只箱子。
lines.en: I see your hand move toward that chest.

lines.zh: 你退出去还来得及，我不追门外。
lines.en: You can still leave; I do not chase past the door.

lines.zh: 门在我身后合上，声音很轻。
lines.en: The door closes behind me, very softly.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一共七下。
lines.en: I count your footsteps: seven in all.

lines.zh: 你踢到砖块，我就在那里。
lines.en: You kick a loose brick, and I am there.

lines.zh: 我的掌心开始聚光，这是警告。
lines.en: Light gathers in my palm; this is a warning.

lines.zh: 你举起剑，我便不必再客气。
lines.en: You raise your sword, so courtesy ends.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头只有你我，和几支火把。
lines.en: At the corridor's end there are only us and a few torches.

lines.zh: 我把身子挪正，挡住了出口。
lines.en: I square my body and block the way out.

lines.zh: 你往左，我堵左，砖缝都记得。
lines.en: You go left; I block left, and the seams remember.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，走快一点就够了。
lines.en: I need not run; walking faster suffices.

lines.zh: 你的火把灭了，我仍看得见你。
lines.en: Your torch dies, and I still see you.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，墙是我的旧友。
lines.en: I keep to the wall; the wall is an old friend.

lines.zh: 你想绕柱，柱子后面是我。
lines.en: You mean to round the pillar, and I am behind it.

lines.zh: 我的目光一直落在你膝上。
lines.en: My gaze stays fixed on your knees.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音，在石室里放大了。
lines.en: Your breathing is magnified in this stone room.

lines.zh: 每一步我都踩在你刚踩过的地方。
lines.en: I set each step exactly where yours just were.

lines.zh: 门锁着，这局你不必跑太远。
lines.en: The door is locked, so you need not run far.

lines.zh: 我把手掌按在墙上，光沿着砖走。
lines.en: I press my palm to the wall and light runs along the bricks.

lines.zh: 你回头看我，我早就在看你了。
lines.en: You turn to look at me; I have been looking all along.

lines.zh: 你上台阶，我在台阶下等着。
lines.en: You climb the steps; I wait at the bottom.

lines.zh: 我走得不急，你总会累。
lines.en: I walk unhurried, and you will tire.

lines.zh: 这一层没有岔路，只有我。
lines.en: There are no side passages on this floor, only me.

lines.zh: 我把手里的光收暗，你就看不远
lines.en: I dim my light so you cannot see far.

lines.zh: 我一掌推出去，你撞在石门上。
lines.en: I thrust a palm and you strike the stone door.

lines.zh: 掌心的光炸开，照得你睁不开眼。
lines.en: The light in my palm bursts and blinds you.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩，把你按在砖上。
lines.en: I seize your shoulder and press you to the bricks.

lines.zh: 这一拳不快，可你没有躲开。
lines.en: This punch is not fast, yet you fail to dodge.

lines.zh: 我的指节敲在你护甲上，像敲钟。
lines.en: My knuckles strike your armor like a bell.

lines.zh: 魔力顺着你的手臂爬，皮肤发凉。
lines.en: Magic crawls up your arm and your skin goes cold.

lines.zh: 我抬脚踩下，石板裂了一道缝。
lines.en: I stamp down and the flagstone splits.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍进我肩膀，我只晃了晃。
lines.en: Your sword bites my shoulder and I merely sway.

lines.zh: 我把你扔向墙，灰尘落了一头。
lines.en: I hurl you at the wall and dust rains down.

lines.zh: 光从我的拳面透出来，落在你胸口。
lines.en: Light shines through my fist and lands on your chest.

lines.zh: 一枚蛋落在地上，我从光里站起来。
lines.en: An egg falls to the floor and I rise out of the light.

lines.zh: 我没有出生，只是被摆在了这里。
lines.en: I was not born; I was simply placed here.

lines.zh: 睁眼的第一件事，是确认门的位置。
lines.en: The first thing I do is confirm where the door is.

lines.zh: 石室接住了我，像接住一件旧物。
lines.en: The stone room receives me like some old object.

lines.zh: 我成形时，火把刚好烧到一半。
lines.en: When I take shape, the torch is exactly half burned.

lines.zh: 我的脚一落地，灰就浮起来了。
lines.en: My feet touch down, and the dust lifts.

lines.zh: 这里没有我的过去，只有这条走廊。
lines.en: There is no past of mine here, only this corridor.

lines.zh: 我抬手，指缝间漏下几粒光尘。
lines.en: I lift my hand and a few grains of light slip through.

lines.zh: 我记得一只手的温度，然后忘了。
lines.en: I remember the warmth of a hand, then forget it.

lines.zh: 门是从外面关上的，我没看见人。
lines.en: The door was shut from outside, and I saw no one.

lines.zh: 我站直时，头顶的砖还在落灰。
lines.en: As I straighten, bricks overhead are still shedding dust.

lines.zh: 我不问为什么，只问该守哪扇门。
lines.en: I do not ask why, only which door to guard.

lines.zh: 光散尽后，我的脸才慢慢有了轮廓。
lines.en: The light fades, and my face slowly finds its outline.

lines.zh: 第一支火把为我亮起，我就留下了。
lines.en: The first torch lit for me, and I stayed.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的手臂，皮肤像蜡在化。
lines.en: Fire sweeps my arm and my skin melts like wax.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下，落地时没有声。
lines.en: I roll down the steps and land without a sound.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的脸，魔力在水里发暗。
lines.en: Water covers my face and my magic dims beneath it.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到墙上，砖落了一地。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the wall and bricks rain down.

lines.zh: 箭穿进我的胸口，卡在光里。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my chest and lodges in the light.

lines.zh: 别的魔法咬住我，我的光被扯开。
lines.en: Another spell bites me and tears my light apart.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿只是光变淡了。
lines.en: I do not eat; hunger is only my light growing pale.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我，我亮得几乎散开。
lines.en: Lightning passes through me and I nearly scatter.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有砖，我的脚踩不到底。
lines.en: In the void there are no bricks under my feet.
